title: Chess, But SCP-939 Hears You Coming...
summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish with neutral SCP-939 (the red lizard) on b4. After each round it moves one square toward the heaviest / highest-value piece that just moved (comparing White's and Black's last moves), capturing whatever is on the square it enters. Equal values -> random choice. Narrator exploits it by moving only pawns so the lizard chases the engine's developing pieces, and SCP-939 eventually captures the black king on g6 to win.
rules: Standard chess otherwise; player White vs Stockfish (3600).

After both sides move, it compares the piece White just moved and the piece Black just moved; it moves one king-step toward the higher-value one (king > queen > rook > minor > pawn); if equal, it picks one at random.
It captures any piece (either colour) on the square it steps onto.
If it steps onto a king, that king's side loses (narrator won when it took the black king on g6).
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish or have SCP-939 capture the black king.
